svg.title: Ongoing / Seams and boundaries
svg.desc: The inventory subsystem under the trust lens: which parts share the one API contract, which are pure rules the browser re-runs, what the durable state is, and which pieces exist so that discovery, hosting, issues, lines of code, the serving host, the deploy target and the export stop being assumptions. All of them are built; only the keyboard-first shell is still a proposal.. Colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members, not inferred trust envelopes.
